span.p:
enforced TWICE (D5):
1. the CoreDataProvider port has
no write methods at all
2. the readycall_ro DB role is granted
SELECT and nothing else

div.style: color: rgb(74, 56, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
why. On hackathon day we are handed
someone else's real data in an unknown
shape. Writing to it is not a risk we get
to take. So the design makes it impossible
rather than discouraged.
